verdict_text:
YES

The artifact's `DROP` set, `kept` list, and `renumber` mapping (`0→0, 1→1, 3→2, 4→3, 5→4, 7→5, 8→6, 9→7, 11→8, 12→9, 13→10, 15→11`) exactly match the required renumbering scheme. Non-layer tensors are copied unchanged, layer tensors are renamed only in their index while `match.group(2)` (the rest of the name) is preserved, and all values/dtypes pass through untouched via straight tensor copy. The script asserts `layers == set(range(12))` (equivalent to enforcing no blocks 12–15 remain and exactly 12 blocks present) and `len(out) == 184` before writing, both `assert`s executing prior to `mkdir`/`save_file`, so failure raises an uncaught `AssertionError` (non-zero exit) with no output written — satisfying the required-checks and fail-loudly clauses.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
